name: Receipt-aware acceptance of waiting reference and capability drafts
summary: Fresh reference/capability accepts consume a waiting draft and refuse an already accepted revision without native writes. Matching operation receipts preserve exact retries and incomplete-write recovery; retained acceptance receipts distinguish fresh consumed-draft requests. Lost-receipt native-identical requests retain legacy no-op recovery, including indistinguishable fresh identities. Inert prior-operator evidence can still be replaced; verification stays a separate attestation.
aliases: accepted revision receipt replay fresh acceptance
